records.source: Ii 'nii win hehl hli gyedihl Gitwinhlguu'l, "Jidaa neejaa wilsi'm, way ii needimdii hasag̲a'm ehl k̲'am hlguts'uusxhl lax̲yiphl dim ksi jebisi'm."
